decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted numbered 793/01, 793/02, 793/03 Received 21/12/2010 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The first floor of Holdsworth House, (65-73 Staines Road), shall be used for an education and training centre and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for education and training centre  purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times Monday-Friday 0900-1800..
description: Retrospective application for the use of the 1st floor for D1 educational use.
